description: This file defines the ProductReviewEntity class, which models a product review within the application. It extends ShopEntity and includes fields such as description, productId, date, and rating, with validation constraints applied.

classes.name: ProductReviewEntity
classes.description: A Java entity class representing a product review, including review description, associated product ID, review date, and rating score.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product being reviewed.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product being reviewed.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the review.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the review.
